description:
List comments on your connected social accounts — recent comments across the account (omit postId) or comments on a specific post (pass postId).

Supported platforms: facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin, threads, bluesky, google-business, mastodon. (tiktok, telegram, twitter, pinterest are NOT engagement platforms.)

postId semantics per platform: media id (instagram/facebook), video id (youtube), post URN (linkedin), thread id (threads), post URI (bluesky), status id (mastodon). google-business does not support postId (reviews are location-level, not per-post).

Returns comments OTHER PEOPLE left you. Replies you authored yourself (auto-posted first comments, your own follow-ups) are marked platformData.isOwnComment and left out by default — pass includeOwn: true to see them too.

On threads this covers both your own posts and replies people left on your outbound replies to other people's threads.

Each returned comment carries an id and a platformData blob. For bluesky, platformData.replyRefs holds the four AT-Protocol refs (parentUri, parentCid, rootUri, rootCid) that reply_to_comment needs — surface them when replying. google-business comments are customer reviews; platformData.starRating carries the 1-5 rating; replying to an already-replied review overwrites the existing reply.

accountId.description: Specific connected account id. Omit to use the first connected account for the platform.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextCursor.

includeOwn.description: Include comments the account itself authored (first comments, your own replies). Default false — they are marked platformData.isOwnComment when shown.

platform.description: Engagement platform: facebook, instagram, youtube, linkedin, threads, bluesky, google-business, or mastodon.

postId.description: Optional. Fetch comments on this specific post instead of recent comments. Platform-specific: media id (instagram/facebook), video id (youtube), post URN (linkedin), thread id (threads), post URI (bluesky), status id (mastodon).

name: list_comments
title: List Comments
